objectives.text: Identify the officers of a local FFA chapter and describe the basic duties of each
Describe how a chapter meeting moves through an order of business from the officer reports to new business
Explain how a chapter Program of Activities organizes the chapter's goals and events for the year
Explain how standing committees divide the work of a chapter and report their progress to the membership
Identify the steps for becoming an active FFA member, including paying dues and affiliating with the state and national organization
Classify chapter activities into the Growing Leaders, Building Communities, and Strengthening Agriculture divisions of the Program of Activities
Participate in chapter business by making a motion, discussing it, and voting on it during a meeting
Explain how holding a chapter office, serving on a committee, and taking part in chapter service and events build leadership and citizenship skills
Interpret a chapter constitution and bylaws to determine how officers are nominated and elected and how the chapter makes decisions
Analyze an existing chapter Program of Activities, budget, and calendar to identify its goals, gaps, and imbalances across divisions
Prepare a chapter budget that forecasts income from fundraisers and dues against expenses for planned activities
Build an outline for a chapter Program of Activities that assigns activities to divisions and committees
Develop a component of the chapter Program of Activities with measurable goals, a timeline, assigned responsibilities, a budget, and an evaluation plan
Design a membership recruitment and retention plan that increases active participation in chapter programs
Evaluate a completed chapter activity against its stated goals and recommend improvements for the next year's Program of Activities
Manage a chapter committee's execution of its portion of the Program of Activities across a school year through delegation, progress reports, and budget tracking
Assemble a National Chapter Award application that documents the chapter's activities, outcomes, and growth across all three divisions
Evaluate how partnerships with the FFA Alumni and Supporters, the agricultural advisory committee, and community stakeholders strengthen chapter programs
